subject: 2024 Leadership Designations
overview: The council members and members-elect held a caucus to conduct non-binding votes designating leadership for calendar year 2024. The caucus designated Councilor Isaac Bears as President and Councilor Kit Collins as Vice President.

items.title: Caucus Opening and Purpose
items.summary: Council President Nicole Morell convened the caucus to conduct non-binding votes for the positions of Council President and Vice President for 2024.

items.title: Designation of Council President
items.summary: Councilor Kit Collins nominated Councilor Isaac Bears for Council President, and the caucus approved the non-binding motion.

items.title: Designation of Council Vice President
items.summary: Councilor Justin Tseng nominated Councilor Kit Collins for Council Vice President, and the caucus approved the non-binding designation.
